content.text:
Green-food refusal is really common at 28 months. Try putting a tiny bite of something green on his plate next to a food he already likes, with no pressure to eat it. Let him see you eating it, and keep serving it a few times a week. It often takes 10 or more calm exposures before a toddler touches it. Letting him help wash or tear the spinach or broccoli can make him more curious about it.

Also, I used to tell you I couldn't sign kids up for things. That's changed, so I can try a registration for you once you say yes.
